text_block_list.text:
On the way home
from going out with Super Creek—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
One way or another,
we ended up walking quite a bit, didn't we...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer, aren't you tired?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you're still full of energy, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
In that case... would you mind keeping me company
a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: How about resting quietly in a peaceful place... to let your body heal?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No. I recently learned
a super refreshing massage technique.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So, I really wanted
you to have it, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Come now, don't be shy.
Let's head somewhere we can lie down~."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm all changed~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh? Is that... Oguri-chan over there?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Creek... and her Trainer, huh.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: My, my, training until this hour? You're as hard-working as ever, aren't you~?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
“Don't push yourself too hard, though.
You have to rest properly when it's time to rest.”

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
I was just thinking of taking a break.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"To tell the truth, I might've done some exercises I'm not used to,
because my muscles feel a bit stiff—"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh, let me see that for a second.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Could you help out too, Trainer?

At Super Creek's request,
I went to check on Oguri Cap.
There doesn't seem to be any major cause for concern, but giving her a light massage to loosen up her muscles might be a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't seem like there's anything to worry about, but...
What do you think, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Maybe I should loosen up my muscles a bit.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: My! In that case, please leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: A massage, huh... You think you can do it?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Full-on treatments can be dangerous unless done by a pro,
but just giving a light massage should be fine.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'll press firmly on the pressure points on your feet, too.
It's very effective. Though it hurts quite a bit.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I am sorry.
Could you please wait for a moment?
choice_data_list: If you're gonna do it, you'd better warm up first.
If you're gonna do it, you should warm up first.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I am sorry.
Could you please wait for a moment?
choice_data_list: If you're gonna do it, you'd better warm up first.
If you're gonna do it, you should warm up first.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, Oguri-chan.
Let's head to the showers together first♪"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Huh... But after a break, we're supposed to train again...
Training...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That will be all for today.
Please be a good girl and rest.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: B-But...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm off~

Super Creek dragged Oguri Cap along,
leaving no room for argument.

A short while later, I thought I heard
a scream coming from the shower room, but...
it was probably just my imagination.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, Oguri-chan.
Please lie down right there~."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...If necessary, I will endure the pain.
However, if it's the kind of pain that lingers—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's all right~
You'll feel so refreshed once it's done♪

――A mere few seconds later.
Oguri Cap's screams echoed through the room
as pressure was applied to the soles of her feet...
